summary: Elaborated every planned dashboard story for iteration dashboard-authenticated-shell with requirements, acceptance criteria, edge cases, assumptions, cross-story rules, and evidence. Preserved planned story ids: protect-dashboard-routing, dashboard-home-shell, collapsible-dashboard-navigation, dashboard-topbar-session-controls, dashboard-theme-toggle, and dashboard-non-browser-verification. Evidence reviewed includes existing Auth.js setup, Prisma session/user schema, landing/sign-in routes, package dependencies, and the absence of a dashboard route. No tests, browser checks, deployments, or background processes were run for this business-analysis task.
